text: The more she doubts, the deader she becomes. But she'll never really die, because she's not really alive.
I'm one of those things.
scene_context: Scene: Winter leans into Amy's space and speaks about truths in the shadows; speaking to Amy Klein about danger and uncertainty.

text: You can't hurt me.
scene_context: Scene: Unknown location, Winter speaks to Pinhead before being attacked with hooks and chains.

text: Oh, but she did. And what makes you so sure she's dead?
scene_context: Scene: In an unspecified location, Winter speaks to Amy about Marla Chen's fate.

text: It's mine now. It belongs to me.
scene_context: Scene: Pinhead approaches Winter and confronts him about his lineage; Winter asserts ownership of the box.

text: I have a room of my own. Kindly join me.
scene_context: Scene: After reviving a young man with a knife in his chest, Winter addresses Amy, who is hidden in the shadows, inviting her to his room.

text: You've gone through this before Amy. Go through it again -- with me.
scene_context: Scene: At the head of a mattress with a puzzle box on an altar; Winter speaks to Amy, urging her to repeat a past experience with him.

text: AMY!
scene_context: Scene near a train track, Winter calls out to Amy as a train approaches.

text: All roads lead home.
scene_context: Scene near a train track, Winter speaks to Amy while screaming over the noise of a passing train.

text: These spaces. That what makes a hand. You get it by taking things away. You, Amy Klein, are the infinitesimal speck that's left when we subtract the infinite possibilities that the space you occupy might have held.
scene_context: Scene: Winter speaks to Amy Klein, explaining a philosophical idea about space and existence.

text: Finish it Amy.
scene_context: Scene where the Deaders are reacting with shock; Winter speaks to Amy, urging her to complete an action.

text: Finish it!
scene_context: Scene where Amy hesitates to act; Winter screams at her to complete the action.

text:
Lie down Amy. It'll only hurt for a
second. I promise.
scene_context: Scene: Winter speaks to Amy as the Deaders approach, urging her to lie down.

text: No more pain. Only pleasure.
scene_context: Scene: Winter speaks to Amy as the Deaders begin to grab her.

text: This thing here isn't a presence. It's an absence. It's a place where things are missing. In all essential qualities, it is less than nothing. In all essential qualities, we are less than nothing. Not solid, not here, not real.
scene_context: Scene: Close on Amy's hand trembling in Winter's grip; Winter speaks about absence and existence, referring to her hand.

text: It created you, and it can destroy you.
Amy, finish it!
scene_context: Scene context involves Winter speaking to Amy, likely during a critical moment involving Pinhead or the Puzzle Box.

text: The ultimate experience.
You say that like it's a good thing.
You know he's watching us.
scene_context: Scene: In a room, Marla whispers to Amy, referring to Winter.

text: Winter. This is where he sends all the trouble makers. Tries to show us who's boss. Tries to make us believe.
scene_context: Scene: In a room, Marla speaks to Amy about Winter and his control over trouble makers.

text: And were you afraid when you saw Marla Chen? Of what you found in the bathroom?
scene_context: Scene: In a room, Winter speaks to Amy, questioning her about her experience with Marla Chen and the bathroom.

text: You took something from her?
scene_context: Scene: In a room, Winter speaks to Amy, questioning her about taking something from Marla Chen.

text: Do you have it with you?
scene_context: Scene: In a room, Winter continues questioning Amy about the item she took, referring to the Puzzle Box.

text:
My great grandfather created that box.
He left it as a...gift. A way to cheatdeath, an entrance to everlasting
pleasures, and it belongs to me. Though
there are others who would disagree.

Really? Should I be honored or afraid
that you are here, Amy Klein. Do you
really think you can just go along with
us for a little ride and then get off
when it suits you? Like your new friends
on the train? You're not going to find it
so easy to get off this train.
I chose you.
scene_context: Scene: In a room, Winter speaks to Amy as she enters and takes a seat opposite him.

text: People come in here the way they want. If it was difficult, then that was the way you wanted it. A little danger. A little mystery. That's what you expected. That's what you found.
scene_context: Scene: In a room, Winter speaks to Amy after she enters, explaining her experience.

text: Were you afraid, Amy? Just now? And during your little "rite of passage" through the walls?
scene_context: Scene: In a room, Winter continues speaking to Amy, questioning her feelings during her entry.

text: You say this is real?
scene_context: Scene: Winter is in front of Amy, holding her hand tightly and questioning the reality of her hand.

text: Epidermis. The dorsal fascia. Transverse carpal ligament across here...The process is taking on an oddly seductive quality.
scene_context: Scene: Winter is touching Amy's hand, describing anatomical parts while creating a seductive atmosphere.

text: The median nerve underneath it. Down here, the carpal bones... And do you think that all those parts are what makes a hand? I'll show you what makes a hand... here...
scene_context: Scene: Winter continues exploring Amy's hand, questioning the nature of a hand's essence while moving his fingers between hers.

text: What did you see?
scene_context: Scene: Winters stands above Amy after she awakens from a trance; Winters is questioning her about her experience.

text: Yes you are, but still you can't run -- you won't run. (studies her) I wonder why that is? (beat) I'm no devil. I'm no monster. Amy, I'll never hurt you and I'll never leave you.
scene_context: Scene: Winters speaks to Amy as she lies surrounded by the Deaders; topic includes fear, trust, and Winters' intentions.

text: Accept my gift. No more fear. No more
scene_context: Scene: Winters offers Amy a knife; continuing the conversation about fear and offering a symbolic or literal release from it.

text: That's it. I knew you were the one. The second I saw you, I knew you were the one.
It's working. I knew it.
scene_context: Scene: Inside a room with the Puzzle Box; Winter speaks to himself or others present as the ritual unfolds.

text: Say it with us Amy. You have to say it with us.
scene_context: Scene: Inside a room with the Puzzle Box; Winter speaks to Amy during a chanting ritual.

text: Yes you can Amy. You're one of us now, all you have to do is take this final step and let the pain go. And welcome aworld of ultimate pleasures.
scene_context: Scene: Inside a room with the Puzzle Box; Winter speaks to Amy, urging her to join the ritual.
